title.zh: 将塔威塔威省卡加延-德塔威塔威市镇的名称变更为马蓬市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Cagayan De Tawi-Tawi in the Province of Tawi-Tawi to Municipality of Mapun
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Cagayan De Tawi-Tawi in the Province of Tawi-Tawi to Municipality of Mapun
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Thị trấn Cagayan De Tawi-Tawi tại Tỉnh Tawi-Tawi thành Thị trấn Mapun
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อเทศบาล Cagayan De Tawi-Tawi ในจังหวัด Tawi-Tawi เป็นเทศบาล Mapun
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Kotamadya Cagayan De Tawi-Tawi di Provinsi Tawi-Tawi menjadi Kotamadya Mapun
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Perbandaran Cagayan De Tawi-Tawi di Wilayah Tawi-Tawi menjadi Perbandaran Mapun

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6672_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Municipality of Cagayan de Tawi-Tawi in the Province of Tawi-Tawi shall hereafter be known as the Municipality of Mapun.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
